meta.scope: Iraq Batch 5 — Provincial / governorate densification: Baghdad, Basra, Erbil and spatial structure framing.

candidates.title: Baghdad governorate economic and fiscal framing
candidates.publisher: Derived from fiscal and statistical sources
candidates.description: Framing of Baghdad as the capital and dominant administrative, services and fiscal centre. Frequently ranks first in total provincial budget allocations and concentrates headquarters, public employment and services activity.

candidates.title: Basra governorate economic and oil framing
candidates.publisher: Derived from oil and fiscal sources
candidates.description: Framing of Basra as the principal southern oil and export hub. Hosts the bulk of federal crude production and export terminals; high fiscal importance and recurrent demands for local resource shares.

candidates.title: Erbil governorate / Kurdistan Region economic framing
candidates.publisher: Derived from KRG and federal sources
candidates.description: Framing of Erbil as the political and commercial centre of the Kurdistan Region. Complements the KRG oil framing with services, trade and administrative activity.

candidates.title: Governorate and spatial structure framing
candidates.publisher: Derived from fiscal and statistical sources
candidates.description: System-level view of Iraq’s governorate structure: oil-producing south (Basra and peers), capital concentration (Baghdad), Kurdistan Region autonomy, and lagging or conflict-affected governorates. Continuously cited in fiscal equalisation, reconstruction and disparity analysis.
referenced_by: Federal budget and oil revenue statistics
candidates.notes: Spatial densification frame for the dual federal–KRG and oil–non-oil structure.

candidates.title: Iraq provincial densification meta-node
candidates.publisher: Derived from fiscal and spatial sources
candidates.description: Meta-node binding Baghdad, Basra, Erbil and governorate-structure framing into a coherent provincial densification layer that complements the oil–fiscal and KRG cores.
referenced_by: All detailed nodes in this batch
Oil, KRG, wage-bill and reconstruction series from earlier batches
candidates.notes: Integrating node for the provincial densification pass.
